title: [Spoofing] Client Identity Spoofing & Broken Auth Token Validation in API Gateway / Reverse Proxy
description:
Adversary sends forged JWTs or replayed credentials to bypass identity verification.
Impact: Unauthorized access to internal endpoints as another authenticated entity.
remediation: Recommended Mitigation: Enforce strict RS256/ES256 asymmetric signature verification, short-lived tokens, and jti revocation list.

title: [Tampering] Data Tampering via Unparameterized Input or Missing State Integrity in Primary Database Store
description:
Untrusted parameters injected into application layer alter database records or transactions.
Impact: Data corruption, financial loss, or unauthorized record modifications.
remediation: Recommended Mitigation: Enforce strict ORM parameterized queries, row-level integrity checks, and least-privilege DB credentials.

title: [Repudiation] Insufficient Audit Trail for Critical Actions & State Transitions in Backend Application Server
description:
Sensitive administrative changes, balance transfers, or permission grants occur without immutable logging.
Impact: Inability to hold malicious actors accountable or reconstruct incident forensics.
remediation: Recommended Mitigation: Implement structured tamper-evident security logging with user IDs, timestamps, client IPs, and append-only log sinks.

title: [Information Disclosure] Sensitive Data Leakage via Error Stack Traces and Verbose Headers in API Gateway / Reverse Proxy
description:
Production endpoints return unhandled exception stack traces, environment variables, or database schemas.
Impact: Exposes internal system topology, library versions, and credentials to potential attackers.
remediation: Recommended Mitigation: Sanitize all error responses, disable debug mode in production, and remove Server/X-Powered-By banners.

title: [Denial of Service] Application Resource Exhaustion via Unthrottled Endpoints (API4) in Backend Application Server
description:
Expensive queries, file uploads, or cryptographic hashing endpoints lack rate limiting and concurrency caps.
Impact: Service outage, thread pool depletion, and cloud billing spike.
remediation: Recommended Mitigation: Implement IP and token-based rate limiting (e.g. token bucket in Redis), strict request body size limits, and timeouts.

title: [Elevation of Privilege] Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) in Backend Application Server
description:
Endpoint does not verify if the requesting authenticated user owns or has rights to the requested resource ID.
Impact: Tenants can read or modify sensitive data belonging to other organizations or administrators.
remediation: Recommended Mitigation: Implement centralized context-aware authorization checks on every data access query (e.g. user_id = current_user.id).

title: [ASVS V7.1.1] Non-compliant: Verify that debug mode and verbose stack traces are disabled in produc...
description:
OWASP ASVS Requirement V7.1.1 (Level 1): Verify that debug mode and verbose stack traces are disabled in production deployments.
Evidence: Debug mode enabled (DEBUG=True) in server.py
owasp: OWASP ASVS Chapter V7: Error Handling & Logging
remediation: Set DEBUG=False and implement standardized generic error handlers.

remediation: Extract secret into environment variables or secrets manager (AWS Secrets Manager / HashiCorp Vault). Invalidate current secret.

title: Unsafe YAML Deserialization
description: Detected pattern `py-insecure-yaml-load` matching dangerous construct in server.py:47.
owasp: OWASP A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Failures
remediation: Use yaml.safe_load() instead of yaml.load() without SafeLoader.

title: Framework Debug Mode Enabled in Code
description: Detected pattern `py-debug-mode-enabled` matching dangerous construct in server.py:59.
remediation: Disable debug mode in production environments via environment variables.

title: Vulnerable Dependency: flask (CVE-2023-30861)
description: Package flask version 2.2.2 is vulnerable: Cookie session disclosure with caching proxies.
remediation: Upgrade flask to version >=2.2.5.

title: Vulnerable Dependency: requests (CVE-2023-32681)
description: Package requests version 2.28.1 is vulnerable: Unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header to destination server.
remediation: Upgrade requests to version >=2.31.0.

title: Vulnerable Dependency: urllib3 (CVE-2023-45803)
description: Package urllib3 version 1.26.12 is vulnerable: Request body not stripped on HTTP redirect causing credential/payload leak.
remediation: Upgrade urllib3 to version >=2.0.7.

title: Vulnerable Dependency: pyyaml (CVE-2020-14343)
description: Package pyyaml version 5.3.1 is vulnerable: Arbitrary code execution through full_load deserialization.
remediation: Upgrade pyyaml to version >=5.4.1.

title: Vulnerable Dependency: axios (CVE-2021-3749)
description: NPM package axios version 0.21.1 is vulnerable: Server-Side Request Forgery via follow-redirects.
remediation: Upgrade axios to version >=0.21.2.

title: Vulnerable Dependency: lodash (CVE-2021-23337)
description: NPM package lodash version 4.17.20 is vulnerable: Command injection via template function.
remediation: Upgrade lodash to version ^4.17.21.

title: Vulnerable Dependency: jsonwebtoken (CVE-2022-23529)
description: NPM package jsonwebtoken version 8.5.1 is vulnerable: Insecure key verification leading to arbitrary code execution.
remediation: Upgrade jsonwebtoken to version >=9.0.0.

title: Sensitive Route Architecture Audit: /api/v1/admin/debug
description: Sensitive route `/api/v1/admin/debug` detected in server.py. Verify strict role-based access control (RBAC) is enforced.
remediation: Attach authentication and authorization middleware to sensitive route controllers.

title: [WSTG WSTG-ATHN-02] Manual Test Failed: Test for Default and Hardcoded Credentials
description:
WSTG Test WSTG-ATHN-02 (Authentication Testing) failed manual/heuristic verification.
Evidence: 3 secrets detected.
remediation: Execute comprehensive manual test steps documented in OWASP WSTG for WSTG-ATHN-02.

title: Exposed High-Value Asset in Attack Surface: .env
description: Sensitive file .env was found in repository root. If packaged into container or web root, it presents immediate exposure.
remediation: Add file to .gitignore, delete from repository history, and inject via environment variables.
